<!-- 中文也可以：说明你想解决的问题，比想要的按钮更有用。 -->

**The problem**
What you are trying to do and where CrossAudit stops you or stays silent.

**What would solve it**
A behaviour, a setting, a surface. If it is a dial, say what the default
should be and why.

**Audit core impact**
Does this touch the generator/auditor separation, the deterministic checks,
the evidence ledger, or receipts? A change there can only make the harness
more fail-closed; say how yours does.

**Both languages**
Any user-visible text must exist in English and Chinese. Proposed wording in
either is welcome.
